title: Etale local integral lattices in the spectral coefficient convention
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l with its canonical spectral-norm topology and recorded valuation ring A. For any scheme X with Noetherian underlying space, every locally free finite-rank E_X-module has a locally free A_U-module M on some quasi-compact quasi-separated etale surjection f:U→X, with a specified scalar-extension isomorphism E_U⊗M≅f*P. No descent or stratification conclusion is asserted. The coefficient extension, pulled coefficients and internal modules are those of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and [sk-def-sfb-module-objects].

source.place: Sheaf of lattices; first etale-local existence paragraph

proof.text: Use the canonical spectral norm on E. Its norm ball equals the recorded valuation ring by continuousIntegers_eq. The spectral norm extends the original p-adic norm, and its induced algebra and field structures agree with the original ones. Apply continuousLisse_etale_lattice. Transport the two continuous-function rings, their inclusion, the module and its free cover along the coefficient equality. The actual scalar extension comparison is preserved. The underlying construction takes a finite coproduct of affine etale pointed lattice neighbourhoods; it is affine, hence qcqs, and covers X by Noetherian compactness. Empty base and rank zero are included. In Lean an explicit congruence first changes the equal scalar maps without unfolding extension of scalars. A private bundled coefficient diagram then transports the whole local-lattice property along equality of the coherent normed and original field/algebra structures; the packing and unpacking lemmas preserve the original scalar-extension types.

proof_origin.place: Etale-local lattice existence paragraph, transported to the spectral coefficient convention.

theorem spectralLisse_etale_lattice
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type) [hField : Field E]
    [hAlg : Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [hFin : FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X] :
    letI := spectralNorm.nontriviallyNormedField ℚ_[l] E
    let A := Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
    let B := Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} E
    let a : A ⟶ B := (sheafCompose (coherentTopology Profinite.{u})
      (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingSheafMap
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E).subtype continuous_subtype_val)
    ∀ L : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj B X),
      LocallyFree (condensedRingObj B X) L →
      ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ X), Etale f ∧ Surjective f ∧
        CompactSpace U ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace U ∧
        ∃ M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj A U),
          LocallyFree (condensedRingObj A U) M ∧
          Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a U)).obj M ≅ (upperStar B f).obj L)
